profile.headline: Embedded Controls & Software Engineer
profile.summary: Personal responsibilities cross through electrical, mechanical, software, control, user interface and safety engineering where all the subsystems are integrated together. In the effort of bringing innovation while simultaneously maintaining safety and efficacy of medical devices for our patients.

positions.title: Principal Embedded Controls & Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and team leader for motion control system. Tasked with developing novel sensing, thermal
and motion algorithms for Karno multi fuel 200kW sterling engine. Architecture for motion system
targets utilizing maximum Carnot cycle efficiency and achieve near ideal thermal utilization.

positions.title: Principal Engineer Front End Innov Lead
positions.description:
Developing next generation electrosurgical and endomechanical platforms. Leveraging control theory and embedded electronics to develop new offerings to clinicians & patients.

https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/patent/US-2024000499-A1
https://patents.google.com/patent/US20250134576A1

positions.title: Staff SW & FW Robotic Controls Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California & Cincinnati, Ohio, United States
positions.description: Individual Contributor for Verb & Auris robotic platforms. Designed, developed, implemented, and tested key product control and safety software algorithms. Addressing issues from prototyping to V&V by performing analysis, evaluated risk, determined root causes, to propose design improvements, and provide solutions. Analyzed complex medical electro-mechanical devices and servo control systems for safety and clinical risk, anticipate potential failure modes, and provide risk mitigation strategies

positions.title: Staff SW & FW Controls Engineer
positions.description: Software team lead for Catalys Laser Cataract System embedded system & host application software development. Secondarily tasked with vetting, then managing external electrical and firmware teams to deliver world class products on time and under budget when internal resources were not sufficient.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Debugging · Electrical Wiring · C (Programming Language) · Cadence Software · Control Systems Design · IAR Embedded Workbench · Research and Development (R&D) · Product Design · Software Development · Programming · ARM Cortex-M

positions.title: Research Engineer - Robotics
positions.description: Joined a multidisciplinary non-profit robotic team to leverage industrial electromechanical design in advanced actuation of humanoid and medical robots. Responsibilities include targeted design of motors, microcontrollers, brushless and stepper drive circuitry, advanced serial and parallel mechanisms.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Electrical Wiring · C (Programming Language) · Cadence Software · Control Systems Design · Research and Development (R&D) · ARM Cortex-M · Altium

positions.title: SW/FW Control Systems Engineer
positions.description: Primary responsibilities included leading design efforts of motion subsystems for document scanners and acquisitions from overseas OEMs. Tasked with the sizing of motors, motor drivers, gearing, trajectory generation, and control algorithms. Mentored firmware teams in transition from LabView RT to embedded controllers. Secondary responsibilities included serving as an internal consultant to product teams determining the root cause of complex system interaction issues between electrical, mechanical, optical and firmware subsystems.
positions.insights: Skills: Electrical Wiring · C (Programming Language) · Control Systems Design · Research and Development (R&D) · Product Design · Software Development · Programming
